product.name: Real Estate Listing Kit
product.description: An editable four-page Canva listing kit at A4 portrait (210 x 297 mm), every page sharing the same navy compliance band and the same fifteen millimetre guide: 1 the window card, 2 the property flyer front, 3 the flyer back sized for a floor plan, and 4 a brochure page with the image top-left and room for copy. Photo frames are already placed to the geometry on the window-card map — drop your own photographs straight in. Plus six reference sheets: the Canva licence clauses on model releases in plain English with the source printed so you can take it to your broker, the window-card map drawn to scale, the property photography shot list, the portal export spec sheet, the hierarchy guide, and the compliance-band sheet (Genius Junkie)
